perform much better.

head_commit.message:
add a slash command to grant sandbox read access to inaccessible directories (#11512)

There is an edge case where a directory is not readable by the sandbox.
In practice, we've seen very little of it, but it can happen so this
slash command unlocks users when it does.

Future idea is to make this a tool that the agent knows about so it can
be more integrated.

head_commit.message:
fix(tui): wrap feedback thread link in backticks

After feedback upload completes for OpenAI employees, we print a
`go/codex-feedback/<thread_id>` snippet to share in #codex-feedback.

Wrap the snippet in backticks so it's ready to paste into Slack as inline
code and is visually distinct from surrounding text.
